home.headline: I build AI tools that save businesses time — and I set up the hardware they run on.
home.intro: By day I deploy AI monitoring systems for hotels, cafes and restaurants: cameras, recorders, sensors and MikroTik networks. In my own projects I build Telegram bots and web tools for the same kind of businesses, with AI coding agents and with tests.
home.relocationText: I am looking for a junior role as an AI developer or an IT/network technician, on site or remote.

about.title: About
about.lead: I work where software meets hardware. I build bots and web tools with AI coding agents, and I install and repair the cameras, sensors and networks those tools depend on.
about.how: AI writes code fast; checking it is my job. Every project on this site runs end to end, has automated tests, and keeps a log of the real bugs I found and fixed while building it.

steady.title: Technical Specialist
steady.text: I deploy and support an AI system that monitors kitchens, service quality and fridge temperatures in hotels, cafes and restaurants. On client sites I install, configure and repair cameras, NVR/DVR recorders, access badges, IoT sensors and MikroTik network equipment.

freelance.title: Freelance IT support & web development
freelance.text: PC setup and repair, home and small-office networks, Wi-Fi coverage and remote support. Telegram bots and websites for small businesses.

family.title: Sales & technical administration
family.text: Customer sales and product consultations, supplier and stock work, and the company's IT: equipment, software and the network.
